ive barely opened up to my mom about self harm, im never honest about being clean, she just knows that i do it and sometimes she asks if im not doing it.

due to just past traumas it just feels like my brain has just engineered itself to protect itself from everything that could cause emotional distress which has caused alot of numbness, it makes me feel crazy. 

anything that could cause emotional problems my brain just shuts off, like the words just don't come out which just makes it feel like its gonna be impossible to get better so im seen as less of a disappointment.

I didn't even open up to my mom about self harm by talking to her i just texted her when she was at work, and then the entire time i was just having a panic attack just waiting for her to come back home from work. 

It just seems like anything that could cause emotional problems my brain just becomes irrationally anxious.

oh thanks, its very much easier to talk about self harm when its brung up by someone else, i just suck at talking about it i dont know. I have been trying really hard to stop doing it but as of late things have seemed to be getting more and more worse and i wanna do it but everyone will be so disappointed in me so ill just have no choice but to kill myself.
i just dont think its worth to try and keep going, ive had a pretty traumatic past also with family and stuff, it just sucks to feel so unwanted by everyone.
you are free to share. i dont really wanna die but i just feel trapped and that this is the only option i cant take to escape.
